log: --- wiring (what the integrator will do in game.js) ---

eval: (async()=>{const g=__game; const m=await import('/src/game/blockentities.js'); if(!g.blockEntities){ g.blockEntities=new m.BlockEntityManager(g).attach(g.world); const orig=g.onInteractBlock.bind(g); g.onInteractBlock=(x,y,z,id,ctx)=>g.blockEntities.useBlock(x,y,z,id,ctx)||orig(x,y,z,id,ctx); setInterval(()=>{ if(!g.paused&&g.state==='playing') g.blockEntities.tick(0.05); },50);} window.__snd=[]; const a=g.audio; const o=a.play.bind(a); a.play=(n,opt)=>{window.__snd.push(n); return o(n,opt);}; return 'wired'})()

(()=>{const g=__game,d=g.debug,p=g.player; d.setTime(6000); const x=Math.floor(p.x), z=Math.floor(p.z)-2; let y=Math.floor(p.y); d.setBlock(x,y,z,'furnace'); d.setBlock(x,y+1,z,'air'); d.setBlock(x,y-1,z,'stone'); window.__F=[x,y,z]; p.inventory.set(9,{id:17,count:8,damage:0}); p.inventory.set(10,{id:257,count:2,damage:0}); p.inventory.set(11,{id:257,count:3,damage:0}); d.lookAt(x+0.5,y+0.5,z+0.5); return {furnace:window.__F, block:d.blockName(x,y,z)}})()
